transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hi. I can't send picture messages from my phone. Normal texts work, but pictures just fail. It's quite annoying.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Sorry about that, Mariam, that is annoying. Can I take your PIN?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thanks. So normal texts send, but picture messages fail every time. Have I got that right?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is your mobile data switched on when you try to send them?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I usually keep it off and use wifi.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's likely the reason. Picture messages need mobile data, even on wifi. Do you have an iPhone or Android?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Have you checked that MMS messaging is switched on in Settings, Messages?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Switch that on, and turn on mobile data. I've also resent the picture message settings to your phone. Restart it when the settings message arrives.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Great, you should be fine now. Anything else?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net, bye.
